name: 正仓院正仓
checkpoints: One long hip-and-tile roof covering all THREE joined repositories, NINE front bays, three bays deep.
The north and south repositories have horizontal triangular log azekura walls; the middle repository uses vertical planks. Preserve the three entrances and high round timber stilts beneath.
No modern railings, visitors, surrounding trees or invented external stairs.
